svg.text: Building the future of healthcare access in Bangladesh through technology and innovation
To democratize healthcare access in Bangladesh by providing a comprehensive, user-friendly platform that connects patients with qualified healthcare providers.
- Make healthcare information easily accessible to everyone
- Empower patients with informed decision-making tools
- Support healthcare providers with digital presence
- Improve healthcare outcomes through better connectivity
To become the leading healthcare information platform in Bangladesh, revolutionizing how people access and interact with healthcare services.

g.text: Every feature is designed with patients’ needs in mind
Clear and honest information about healthcare providers
Maintaining high standards in healthcare information

svg.text: • Create a comprehensive healthcare provider directory
• Improve healthcare accessibility in rural areas
• Healthcare Access: 85% improvement in rural areas
• Service Speed: 60% reduction in search time
• User Satisfaction: 92% based on user feedback
Open Care platform officially launched with core features:

g.text: Comprehensive database of qualified healthcare professionals
Complete information about hospitals, clinics, and medical facilities
Information about medical institutions and educational programs
HIPAA-compliant security measures to protect sensitive health information
Optimized for all devices with seamless mobile experience
Support for Bangla and English languages for better accessibility
Intuitive interface designed for easy navigation and usability
Engagement with healthcare professionals and users for continuous improvement
